subject.title: [Feature] Compaction progress visibility for webchat + watchdog diagnostics API

question: Should OpenClaw add a compaction-specific staged Gateway/WebChat diagnostics contract now, and what compaction facts are safe to expose to WebChat users or operators?
rationale: The missing behavior is real by source inspection, but the fix would create public event/API or CLI surface and diagnostic redaction policy, while the Session Memory part overlaps an existing plugin-path decision.

options.title: Narrow core observability contract
options.body: Extend existing compaction events and diagnostics with bounded stage, duration, token, and failure metadata while documenting running summaries as a context-engine plugin pattern.

options.title: Docs and plugin path only
options.body: Keep current start/end indicators and generic diagnostics, then let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100400 or a follow-up improve context-engine guidance without new core API surface.

options.title: Dedicated diagnostics API or CLI
options.body: Add a separate compaction diagnostics endpoint or command with explicit operator scope, retention limits, and redaction rules for lock/model/session details.

recommendation.title: Narrow core observability contract
recommendation.body: Extend existing compaction events and diagnostics with bounded stage, duration, token, and failure metadata while documenting running summaries as a context-engine plugin pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: The current WebChat compaction event path and Gateway handler blame route most directly through steipete, while the final decision crosses Gateway/WebChat product surface.
